title: Synthetic attention notes (pipeline example, not scholarly evidence)

lines.text: In these invented notes, deliberate attention means selecting
a target voluntarily while other signals remain available.
The exercise requires the learner to notice a target first.
Practice: choose one sound and return to it after a distraction.
This description concerns subjective reports, not measured performance.
# A different use of the term
The second invented account calls involuntary capture by a loud sound attention.
It does not require voluntary control or the same intended outcome.
